decisions.rationale: The function of a seed is a distinct biological fact and is not a restatement of any frozen cohort fact.
The cell type infected by HIV is a distinct biological fact and is not a restatement of any frozen cohort fact.
Characteristics of civilization form a distinct social-science fact and do not duplicate a frozen cohort fact.
The instrument used with a wah-wah pedal is distinct from every frozen cohort fact.
Howard Stern's on-air sidekick is a distinct person-role fact, not a character-actor or song-performer cohort fact.
The treaty-law condition for an invalid reservation is a distinct legal fact and not a cohort paraphrase.
The classification of silk and cotton as natural fibers is a distinct science fact.
The term for nonliving ecosystem factors is a distinct science fact and not a cohort paraphrase.
The location of cardiac muscle is a distinct anatomy fact.
The environmental pressure faced by deep-ocean organisms is a distinct biology fact.
The cell type with a preprophase stage is a distinct cell-biology fact.
Japan's most popular sport is a distinct cultural fact and not a cohort fact.
Whether spouses can be arrested for the same crime is a distinct legal fact and not a cohort paraphrase.
